meaning: Each instance p ∨ ¬p is constructively irrefutable (¬¬(p ∨ ¬p) needs no axiom); double-negation elimination removes the double negation. A relocation to an equivalent logical floor (STMT-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE-IFF-DOUBLE-NEGATION-ELIMINATION), not a derivation from a weaker one: constructive logic proves only the irrefutability of excluded middle (STMT-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE-NOT-DENIABLE), not excluded middle itself.
